#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generates output.svg - an animated horse race scene (standalone, no external assets)."""
import random

random.seed(20261115)

S = []
def w(s):
    S.append(s)

W, H = 1200, 800

def path_of(cmds):
    out = []
    for c, nums in cmds:
        out.append(c + " ".join(("%g" % round(n, 1)) for n in nums))
    return " ".join(out)

def perturb(cmds, edits):
    new = []
    for i, (c, nums) in enumerate(cmds):
        nums = list(nums)
        for pos, d in edits.get(i, []):
            nums[pos] += d
        new.append((c, nums))
    return path_of(new)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- header
w('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>')
w('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" '
  'viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800" role="img" '
  'aria-labelledby="ttl dsc">')
w('<title id="ttl">Thrilling horse race at full gallop</title>')
w('<desc id="dsc">Five racehorses with jockeys galloping head to head toward a finish line, '
  'with a packed grandstand, waving flags, a tote board, a big screen and a photo-finish camera.</desc>')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- defs
w('<defs>')
w('<linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#1c5fae"/><stop offset="0.42" stop-color="#5aa8dd"/>'
  '<stop offset="0.76" stop-color="#a9d8ee"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffe6b8"/></linearGradient>')
w('<radialGradient id="sunG" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#fffdf0"/><stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#ffe79a"/>'
  '<stop offset="0.78" stop-color="#ffc95c" stop-opacity="0.55"/>'
  '<stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffb43c" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="cloudG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff"/><stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#f2f8ff"/>'
  '<stop offset="1" stop-color="#c3dcf0"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="hillG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#7fae63"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#4f7f45"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="hillG2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#6d9d5c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#3f6b3e"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="trackG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#4e8f45"/><stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#5ea24f"/>'
  '<stop offset="1" stop-color="#3c7239"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="stripeA" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#79b862"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#5c9a4c"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="stripeB" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#5f9f4f"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#47823f"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="railG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b9c4c9"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="standG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#4a3b33"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#2e2521"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="roofG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#e8eef2"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#c3ced6"/>'
  '<stop offset="1" stop-color="#8e9ba5"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="screenG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e2340"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1d3f66"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="toteG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#10161d"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1e2a35"/></linearGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="vig" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.30"/>'
  '<stop offset="0.28" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>'
  '<stop offset="0.75" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>'
  '<stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.34"/></linearGradient>')
w('<radialGradient id="vigR" cx="0.5" cy="0.45" r="0.75">'
  '<stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>'
  '<stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.34"/></radialGradient>')
w('<linearGradient id="flashG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">'
  '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>'
  '<stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.95"/>'
  '<stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient>')
w('<filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">'
  '<feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3"/></filter>')
w('<filter id="softer" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">'
  '<feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7"/></filter>')

# horse coats
COATS = [
    dict(coat="#b8562c", dark="#7d3519", light="#d9793f", mane="#3a2113", tail="#3a2113", name="chestnut"),
    dict(coat="#3b3038", dark="#221b22", light="#584a55", mane="#171116", tail="#171116", name="black"),
    dict(coat="#d9d5cd", dark="#a49e94", light="#f2efe8", mane="#f0eee8", tail="#f4f2ed", name="grey"),
    dict(coat="#8a3f1e", dark="#5b2510", light="#b05c30", mane="#1d1310", tail="#1d1310", name="bay"),
    dict(coat="#d8a256", dark="#a97a35", light="#ecc37e", mane="#f2e3c4", tail="#f2e3c4", name="dun"),
]
for i, c in enumerate(COATS):
    w('<linearGradient id="coat%d" x1="0"1" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'.replace('1"1"', '"1"'))
    w('<stop offset="0" stop-color="%s"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="%s"/>'
      '<stop offset="1" stop-color="%s"/></linearGradient>' % (c["light"], c["coat"], c["dark"]))
    w('<linearGradient id="silk%d" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">'
      '<stop offset="0" stop-color="%s"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="%s"/></linearGradient>'
      % (c["light"], c["dark"]))
w('</defs>')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- sky
w('<rect x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="470" fill="url(#sky)"/>')

# sun glow + disc + rotating rays
w('<g>')
w('<circle cx="1010" cy="104" r="150" fill="url(#sunG)" opacity="0.75"/>')
w('<g opacity="0.55" transform="translate(1010,104)">')
w('<g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" '
  'dur="64s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>')
for i in range(16):
    a = i * 22.5
    w('<path d="M -3,-58 L 0,-96 L 3,-58 Z" fill="#ffe9a8" transform="rotate(%g)"/>' % a)
w('</g></g>')
w('<circle cx="1010" cy="104" r="44" fill="#fff8dc"/>')
w('<circle cx="1010" cy="104" r="33" fill="#fffdf2"/>')
w('</g>')

# birds
for i, (bx, by, bs, bd) in enumerate([(300, 120, 1.0, 9), (352, 96, 0.8, 11), (250, 82, 0.7, 10),
                                       (880, 168, 0.75, 12), (930, 150, 0.6, 11)]):
    w('<g opacity="0.5" transform="translate(%g,%g) scale(%g)">' % (bx, by, bs))
    w('<g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 210 -34; 0 0" '
      'dur="%gs" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="%gs"/>' % (bd, i * 1.7))
    w('<path d="M -9,0 Q -4,-6 0,-1 Q 4,-6 9,0" fill="none" stroke="#2b3a4a" stroke-width="1.8" '
      'stroke-linecap="round"><animate attributeName="d" '
      'values="M -9,0 Q -4,-6 0,-1 Q 4,-6 9,0; M -9,0 Q -4,2 0,-1 Q 4,2 9,0; M -9,0 Q -4,-6 0,-1 Q 4,-6 9,0" '
      'dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></path>')
    w('</g></g>')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- clouds (parallax)
def cloud(x, y, s, dur, tint, op):
    parts = [(-46, 8, 34, 20), (-16, -4, 40, 26), (18, -2, 34, 23), (48, 8, 30, 18), (4, 14, 46, 16)]
    g = ['<g opacity="%g" transform="translate(%g,%g) scale(%g)">' % (op, x, y, s)]
    g.append('<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" '
             'values="0 0; 1560 0" dur="%gs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>' % dur)
    for (px, py, rx, ry) in parts:
        g.append('<ellipse cx="%g" cy="%g" rx="%g" ry="%g" fill="url(#cloudG)"/>' % (px, py, rx, ry))
    g.append('<ellipse cx="-6" cy="18" rx="62" ry="10" fill="#9fc4de" opacity="0.35"/>')
    g.append('</g>')
    return "".join(g)

w(cloud(-260, 96, 0.72, 128, None, 0.80))
w(cloud(-260, 150, 0.95, 96, None, 0.86))
w(cloud(-260, 62, 0.5, 168, None, 0.62))
w(cloud(-260, 205, 1.25, 74, None, 0.92))
w(cloud(-260, 250, 1.5, 58, None, 0.95))
w(cloud(-260, 180, 0.85, 104, None, 0.78))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- hills + treeline
w('<path d="M 0,318 C 90,286 150,300 236,286 C 320,272 372,296 470,284 C 560,272 640,292 720,280 '
  'C 820,266 900,290 1010,276 C 1090,266 1150,278 1200,272 L 1200,470 L 0,470 Z" fill="url(#hillG2)"/>')
w('<path d="M 0,352 C 120,326 210,344 320,330 C 430,316 520,338 640,326 C 760,314 860,336 980,324 '
  'C 1080,314 1140,326 1200,320 L 1200,470 L 0,470 Z" fill="url(#hillG)"/>')
# trees
for i in range(46):
    x = i * 27 + random.uniform(-9, 9)
    y = 360 + random.uniform(-6, 14)
    r = random.uniform(11, 20)
    dark = random.choice(["#2f5c37", "#37663d", "#2a5433"])
    w('<ellipse cx="%g" cy="%g" rx="%g" ry="%g" fill="%s" opacity="0.95"/>'
      % (x, y, r, r * 0.85, dark))
w('<rect x="0" y="392" width="1200" height="62" fill="#356a3b" opacity="0.9"/>')
w('<rect x="0" y="392" width="1200" height="62" fill="url(#vig)"/>')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- grandstand structure
w('<g id="grandstand">')
# back building
w('<path d="M 6,452 L 6,318 L 648,318 L 648,452 Z" fill="url(#standG)"/>')
w('<rect x="6" y="318" width="642" height="134" fill="#3a2f29"/>')
# roof
w('<path d="M -14,286 L 660,286 L 690,336 L 18,336 Z" fill="url(#roofG)"/>')
w('<path d="M -14,286 L 660,286 L 660,300 L -14,300 Z" fill="#f4f8fb"/>')
w('<path d="M 18,336 L 690,336 L 690,344 L 18,344 Z" fill="#7b8790"/>')
# roof supports
for x in range(24, 680, 74):
    w('<rect x="%g" y="344" width="7" height="108" fill="#3c3330" opacity="0.85"/>' % x)
# shadowed seating bowl
w('<rect x="18" y="344" width="672" height="108" fill="#241d1a" opacity="0.55"/>')

# crowd
SKIN = ["#f0c8a0", "#e0aa7c", "#c98d5f", "#8d5a35", "#f6d9b8", "#a9713f"]
SHIRT = ["#d94f4f", "#3f6fd9", "#f2c14e", "#4fb477", "#e8743f", "#b45fc9", "#f4f4f4",
         "#2f4858", "#e0567f", "#59c2d9", "#f08c35", "#8fd06a", "#e3e0d4", "#7a4bbf"]
HAIR = ["#2b1d15", "#4a3323", "#7b5230", "#151010", "#a4763f", "#d9b483"]
crowd = []
row_y = 350.0
for row in range(13):
    y = 350 + row * 8.0
    sc = 0.72 + row * 0.055
    x = 26 + random.uniform(-6, 6)
    while x < 676:
        crowd.append((x, y, sc))
        x += random.uniform(12.5, 17.5) * (0.85 + row * 0.03)

def figure(x, y, s, idx):
    skin = random.choice(SKIN)
    shirt = random.choice(SHIRT)
    hair = random.choice(HAIR)
    g = ['<g transform="translate(%.1f,%.1f)">' % (x, y)]
    body = ('<path d="M %.1f,%.1f q %.1f,%.1f %.1f,%.1f l 0,%.1f q %.1f,%.1f %.1f,%.1f Z" fill="%s"/>'
            % (-3.4 * s, 2.6 * s, 3.4 * s, -0.4 * s, 6.8 * s, 0, 9.2 * s,
               -3.4 * s, 0.6 * s, -6.8 * s, 0, shirt))
    g.append(body)
    g.append('<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="%.2f" fill="%s"/>' % (3.1 * s, skin))
    g.append('<path d="M %.2f,-%.2f a %.2f,%.2f 0 0 1 %.2f,0 z" fill="%s"/>'
             % (-3.1 * s, 0.9 * s, 3.1 * s, 3.2 * s, 6.2 * s, hair))
    # arms / waving
    mode = idx % 9
    if mode in (0, 3, 6):
        dur = 0.9 + (idx % 5) * 0.16
        beg = (idx % 7) * 0.21
        g.append('<g transform="translate(%.2f,%.2f)"><g>'
                 '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '
                 'values="-26;26;-26" dur="%.2fs" begin="%.2fs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
                 % (-3.4 * s, 3.4 * s, dur, beg))
        g.append('<path d="M 0,0 L %.2f,%.2f" stroke="%s" stroke-width="%.2f" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
                 % (1.2 * s, -8.5 * s, skin, 1.9 * s))
        g.append('</g></g>')
    elif mode in (1, 4, 7):
        # little flag
        dur = 1.1 + (idx % 4) * 0.2
        beg = (idx % 6) * 0.31
        fc = random.choice(["#e94b3c", "#f7c948", "#3aa0e0", "#4cb96b", "#ffffff"])
        g.append('<g transform="translate(%.2f,%.2f)"><g>'
                 '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '
                 'values="-14;16;-14" dur="%.2fs" begin="%.2fs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
                 % (3.6 * s, 3.0 * s, dur, beg))
        g.append('<path d="M 0,0 L 0,%.2f" stroke="#4b4b4b" stroke-width="%.2f"/>' % (-13 * s, 1.1 * s))
        g.append('<path d="M 0,%.2f L %.2f,%.2f L 0,%.2f Z" fill="%s"/>'
                 % (-13 * s, 8.5 * s, -10.2 * s, -8.2 * s, fc))
        g.append('</g></g>')
    g.append('</g>')
    return "".join(g)

for i, (cx, cy, cs) in enumerate(crowd):
    w(figure(cx, cy, cs, i))
w('</g>')

# roof flags on the stand
for i, fx in enumerate([70, 190, 310, 430, 550, 630]):
    fh = 34 + (i % 3) * 7
    fc = ["#e94b3c", "#f7c948", "#3aa0e0", "#4cb96b", "#ffffff", "#e07ab5"][i]
    w('<g transform="translate(%g,286)">' % fx)
    w('<rect x="-1" y="%.1f" width="2.4" height="%.1f" fill="#e6e6e6"/>' % (-fh, fh))
    w('<g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '
      'values="-6;9;-6" dur="%.2fs" begin="%.2fs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>' % (1.5 + i * 0.12, i * 0.4))
    w('<path d="M 1.2,%.1f C 12,%.1f 22,%.1f 34,%.1f C 24,%.1f 14,%.1f 1.2,%.1f Z" fill="%s"/>'
      % (-fh + 2, -fh + 7, -fh + 1, -fh + 5, -fh + 12, -fh + 13, -fh + 2, fc))
    w('</g></g>')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- big screen
w('<g id="bigscreen">')
w('<rect x="214" y="128" width="248" height="162" rx="6" fill="#20272c"/>')
w('<rect x="222" y="136" width="232" height="146" rx="3" fill="url(#screenG)"/>')
# screen contents: mini race
w('<clipPath id="scr"><rect x="222" y="136" width="232" height="146" rx="3"/></clipPath>')
w('<g clip-path="url(#scr)">')
w('<rect x="222" y="136" width="232" height="146" fill="#0f2745"/>')
w('<rect x="222" y="242" width="232" height="40" fill="#3f8a3d"/>')
w('<rect x="222" y="256" width="232" height="26" fill="#4c9c47"/>')
w('<rect x="330" y="242" width="16" height="40" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.55"/>')
for i, (sy, sc, col) in enumerate([(250, 0.55, "#b8562c"), (246, 0.5, "#d9d5cd"),
                                    (254, 0.6, "#3b3038"), (258, 0.58, "#d8a256")]):
    w('<g transform="translate(0,%g) scale(%g)">' % (sy, sc))
    w('<g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" '
      'values="0 0; 300 0" dur="%gs" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="%gs"/>' % (9 + i * 1.3, i * 0.9))
    w('<ellipse cx="0" cy="-16" rx="26" ry="13" fill="%s"/>' % col)
    w('<path d="M 20,-18 C 30,-26 40,-30 48,-26 L 52,-20 C 44,-24 34,-20 26,-14 Z" fill="%s"/>' % col)
    w('<rect x="-18" y="-6" width="5" height="20" fill="%s"/>' % col)
    w('<rect x="-8" y="-6" width="5" height="20" fill="%s"/>' % col)
    w('<rect x="12" y="-6" width="5" height="20" fill="%s"/>' % col)
    w('<rect x="20" y="-6" width="5" height="20" fill="%s"/>' % col)
    w('<circle cx="-2" cy="-32" r="6" fill="#ffd9a8"/>')
    w('</g></g>')
w('<text x="232" y="158" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff">'
  'RACE 7  ·  1200m</text>')
w('<g><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0.15;1" keyTimes="0;0.1;0.2;1" dur="1.6s" '
  'repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
  '<circle cx="436" cy="152" r="6" fill="#ff4d4d"/><text x="414" y="157" font-family="sans-serif" '
  'font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#ff8a8a">LIVE</text></g>')
w('</g></g>')
w('<rect x="214" y="128" width="248" height="162" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#39434b" stroke-width="4"/>')
w('<rect x="300" y="290" width="76" height="12" fill="#2c343a"/>')
w('</g>')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- tote board
w('<g id="toteboard">')
w('<rect x="676" y="188" width="272" height="266" rx="6" fill="#2a2f35"/>')
w('<rect x="686" y="198" width="252" height="246" rx="4" fill="url(#toteG)"/>')
w('<rect x="686" y="198" width="252" height="30" fill="#c0392b"/>')
w('<text x="812" y="219" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" '
  'text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="2">TOTE BOARD</text>')
w('<text x="700" y="248" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#8fa2b2">NO</text>')
w('<text x="760" y="248" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#8fa2b2">RIDER</text>')
w('<text x="884" y="248" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#8fa2b2">ODDS</text>')
entries = [(4, "VELOCITY", ["2.4", "2.1", "1.9", "2.6"], "#f2c14e"),
           (7, "BLACKJACK", ["5.5", "6.0", "4.8", "5.2"], "#e8e8e8"),
           (2, "SILVERMANE", ["8.0", "7.4", "9.2", "8.6"], "#cfd8dc"),
           (9, "ROYAL TARTAN", ["11.0", "10.2", "12.5", "9.8"], "#7fb3e8"),
           (5, "GOLD RUSH", ["14.5", "15.2", "13.8", "16.0"], "#e8b44a")]
for i, (num, nm, odds, col) in enumerate(entries):
    y = 276 + i * 34
    w('<rect x="694" y="%g" width="236" height="28" rx="3" fill="#18212a"/>' % (y - 20))
    w('<rect x="700" y="%g" width="22" height="22" rx="3" fill="%s"/>' % (y - 16, col))
    w('<text x="711" y="%g" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#101418" '
      'text-anchor="middle">%d</text>' % (y + 1, num))
    w('<text x="732" y="%g" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#e6edf3">%s</text>' % (y + 1, nm))
    for k, od in enumerate(odds):
        w('<text x="900" y="%g" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#7fe3a0" '
          'text-anchor="middle" opacity="%g"><animate attributeName="opacity" calcMode="discrete" '
          'values="%g;%g;%g;%g" dur="8s" begin="%gs" repeatCount="indefinite"/></text>'
          % (y + 1, 1 if k == 0 else 0, 1 if k == 0 else 0, 1 if k == 1 else 0,

w('<rect x="676" y="188" width="272" height="266" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#151a1f" stroke-width="4"/>')
w('<rect x="694" y="452" width="18" height="16" fill="#2a2f35"/>')
w('<rect x="912" y="452" width="18" height="16" fill="#2a2f35"/>')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- far rail, grass, track
w('<rect x="0" y="452" width="1200" height="14" fill="#4b8b45"/>')
w('<rect x="0" y="456" width="1200" height="344" fill="url(#trackG)"/>')
# mown stripes
y = 462.0
band = 30.0
idx = 0

def cloud(x, y, s, dur, tint, op):
    parts = [(-46, 8, 34, 20), (-16, -4, 40, 26), (18, -2, 34, 23), (48, 8, 30, 18), (4, 14, 46, 16)]
    g = ['<g opacity="%g" transform="translate(%g,%g) scale(%g)">' % (op, x, y, s)]
    g.append('<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum" '
             'values="0 0; 1560 0" dur="%gs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>' % dur)
    for (px, py, rx, ry) in parts:
        g.append('<ellipse cx="%g" cy="%g" rx="%g" ry="%g" fill="url(#cloudG)"/>' % (px, py, rx, ry))
    g.append('<ellipse cx="-6" cy="18" rx="62" ry="10" fill="#9fc4de" opacity="0.35"/>')
    g.append('</g>')
    return "".join(g)

def figure(x, y, s, idx):
    skin = random.choice(SKIN)
    shirt = random.choice(SHIRT)
    hair = random.choice(HAIR)
    g = ['<g transform="translate(%.1f,%.1f)">' % (x, y)]
    body = ('<path d="M %.1f,%.1f q %.1f,%.1f %.1f,%.1f l 0,%.1f q %.1f,%.1f %.1f,%.1f Z" fill="%s"/>'
            % (-3.4 * s, 2.6 * s, 3.4 * s, -0.4 * s, 6.8 * s, 0, 9.2 * s,
               -3.4 * s, 0.6 * s, -6.8 * s, 0, shirt))
    g.append(body)
    g.append('<circle cx="0" cy="0" r="%.2f" fill="%s"/>' % (3.1 * s, skin))
    g.append('<path d="M %.2f,-%.2f a %.2f,%.2f 0 0 1 %.2f,0 z" fill="%s"/>'
             % (-3.1 * s, 0.9 * s, 3.1 * s, 3.2 * s, 6.2 * s, hair))
    # arms / waving
    mode = idx % 9
    if mode in (0, 3, 6):
        dur = 0.9 + (idx % 5) * 0.16
        beg = (idx % 7) * 0.21
        g.append('<g transform="translate(%.2f,%.2f)"><g>'
                 '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '
                 'values="-26;26;-26" dur="%.2fs" begin="%.2fs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
                 % (-3.4 * s, 3.4 * s, dur, beg))
        g.append('<path d="M 0,0 L %.2f,%.2f" stroke="%s" stroke-width="%.2f" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
                 % (1.2 * s, -8.5 * s, skin, 1.9 * s))
        g.append('</g></g>')
    elif mode in (1, 4, 7):
        # little flag
        dur = 1.1 + (idx % 4) * 0.2
        beg = (idx % 6) * 0.31
        fc = random.choice(["#e94b3c", "#f7c948", "#3aa0e0", "#4cb96b", "#ffffff"])
        g.append('<g transform="translate(%.2f,%.2f)"><g>'
                 '<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '
                 'values="-14;16;-14" dur="%.2fs" begin="%.2fs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
                 % (3.6 * s, 3.0 * s, dur, beg))
        g.append('<path d="M 0,0 L 0,%.2f" stroke="#4b4b4b" stroke-width="%.2f"/>' % (-13 * s, 1.1 * s))
        g.append('<path d="M 0,%.2f L %.2f,%.2f L 0,%.2f Z" fill="%s"/>'
                 % (-13 * s, 8.5 * s, -10.2 * s, -8.2 * s, fc))
        g.append('</g></g>')
    g.append('</g>')
    return "".join(g)

def leg(hipx, hipy, dur, phase, front, far, coat_dark, coat):
    """One two-segment leg with a gallop cycle."""
    g = ['<g transform="translate(%g,%g)">' % (hipx, hipy)]
    if far:
        g.append('<g opacity="0.92">')
    g.append('<g>')
    if front:
        g.append('<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '
                 'values="-40;-18;10;32;-40" dur="%gs" begin="%gs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
                 % (dur, phase))
    else:
        g.append('<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '
                 'values="38;12;-16;-34;38" dur="%gs" begin="%gs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
                 % (dur, phase))
    fill = coat_dark if far else coat
    g.append('<path d="%s" fill="%s"/>' % (path_of(UPPER_LEG), fill))
    g.append('<g transform="translate(0,60)">')
    g.append('<g>')
    g.append('<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '
             'values="14;52;26;6;14" dur="%gs" begin="%gs" repeatCount="indefinite"/>'
             % (dur, phase))
    g.append('<path d="%s" fill="%s"/>' % (path_of(LOWER_LEG), fill))
    g.append('<path d="%s" fill="#2a2119"/>' % path_of(HOOF))
    g.append('</g></g>')
    g.append('</g>')
    if far:
        g.append('</g>')
    g.append('</g>')
    return "".join(g)

def leg(hipx, hipy, dur, phase, front, far, coat_dark, coat):
    """One two-segment leg with a gallop cycle (fast forward reach, slower push)."""
    g = ['<g transform="translate(%g,%g)">' % (hipx, hipy)]
    if far:
        g.append('<g opacity="0.9">')

                 'repeatCount="indefinite"/>' % (dur, phase))
    else:
        g.append('<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '

                 'repeatCount="indefinite"/>' % (dur, phase))
    fill = coat_dark if far else coat
    up = UPPER_LEG_F if front else UPPER_LEG_H
    g.append('<path d="%s" fill="%s"/>' % (path_of(up), fill))

        g.append('<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" '

                 'repeatCount="indefinite"/>' % (dur, phase))
    g.append('<circle cx="0" cy="2" r="6" fill="%s"/>' % fill)
    g.append('<path d="%s" fill="%s"/>' % (path_of(LOWER_LEG), fill))
    g.append('<path d="%s" fill="#2a2119"/>' % path_of(HOOF))
    g.append('</g></g>')
    g.append('</g>')
    if far:
        g.append('</g>')
    g.append('</g>')
    return "".join(g)
